_comment: Base configuration for @playwright/cli in a session container. The
entrypoint copies this to ~/.playwright/cli.config.json -- the CLI's
documented global config -- adding the egress proxy, which is only known
at runtime. A project's own .playwright/cli.config.json still overrides
browserName: the CLI defaults to the 'chrome' channel and looks for real
Google Chrome at /opt/google/chrome/chrome, which is not what this image
installs. Without this the browser refuses to open at all.
chromiumSandbox: Chromium's own sandbox needs a user namespace, and
Docker's seccomp profile denies one to a container without CAP_SYS_ADMIN,
which this container deliberately does not have. Left on, the browser
dies at startup with 'Chromium sandboxing failed'. The container is the
sandbox instead: non-root, no capabilities, read-only rootfs, no route out
but the proxy. Note this differs from the Playwright library, where
Chromium exhausts on any substantial page and reports as a closed target.
This moves that traffic to /tmp, already a 512 MB tmpfs here.
